description: Node.js 24.21.0 runtime archive for Ubuntu 24.04 amd64; exact vendor artifact pinned for local web development.
purpose: Provide a reproducible Node.js runtime for project-selected web development tasks.
detection: Manual eligibility check: confirm Ubuntu 24.04 amd64, the vendor floor (Linux kernel >= 4.18 and glibc >= 2.28 on a vendor-supported, non-EOL distribution; current platform facts do not expose kernel/libc versions.), and that the OS release is still vendor-supported. Version/kernel/libc qualification is not available in MachineFacts for this platform cell; unknown never qualifies.
license_notes: Node.js is MIT-licensed. The upstream distribution contains third-party components with separate license terms; retain and review all included notices. This recipe does not redistribute the archive.
side_effects: Manual download and extraction into an Anza-managed, user-writable runtime location; no global PATH or project-file mutation is specified.
verification: Before use, verify the signed SHASUMS256.txt.asc with the official Node.js release keyring using gpgv, then compare this artifact SHA-256; confirm node --version reports v24.21.0. The source signature and downloaded artifact were not locally verified in this task.
